title: The answer is an interface.
takeaway: An answer can be a tool you can use.
proof: Changing baseline updates quartiles and deltas; month choices focus the comparison; export retains that view.
limits: Reconstructed control gestures using archived scientific data; unselected months remain faint chart context.
hardest: Controls, pointer and linked values must agree while rows collapse smoothly.

copy.text: Ask a question. Get something you can explore.
Change the controls. See the data respond.
